name: v6-dunn-py
description: Federated Dunn's post-hoc test with Kruskal-Wallis: pairwise mean-rank comparisons on approximate global ranks, without any node sharing individual values.

functions.name: dunn
functions.description: Federated Dunn's post-hoc test (pairwise mean-rank comparisons after Kruskal-Wallis) on binned global ranks, without any node sharing individual values

arguments.name: column
arguments.description: Numeric column whose ranks are compared.

arguments.name: p_adjust
arguments.description: Multiple-comparison adjustment: bonferroni (default), holm, fdr_bh or none.

arguments.name: alpha
arguments.description: Significance level for the reject flags (default 0.05).

arguments.name: organizations_to_include
arguments.description: Organizations to include in the analysis. Defaults to all organizations in the collaboration.

functions.name: compute_local_moments
functions.description: Round 1: count, sum and sum of squares of the eligible values.

arguments.name: column
arguments.description: Numeric column whose ranks are compared.

functions.name: compute_local_histogram
functions.description: Round 2: group-blind record counts per bin of the shared grid.

arguments.name: column
arguments.description: Numeric column whose ranks are compared.

arguments.name: edges
arguments.description: Bin edges laid out by the central function.

functions.name: compute_local_rank_scores
functions.description: Round 3: per group, count, sum and sum of squares of the rank scores.

arguments.name: column
arguments.description: Numeric column whose ranks are compared.

arguments.name: edges
arguments.description: Rank-bin edges derived by the central function.

arguments.name: mid_ranks
arguments.description: Global mid-rank of each rank bin.
